rv.q: I didn't feel this final installment was staged with as much intensity and realism as the dynamic 'October Storm,' with 'Prodigal Daughter' sometimes veering into overly broad comedy and with some moments when the rules of theatrical engagement felt unclear. But none of that spoiled this rich drama nor Mattos' formidable performance.
'The Prodigal Daughter' tells tough truths mixed with enough sugar to help the bitter pill go down easy, a fitting climax to 'The Grand Boulevard Trilogy.'
A good and interesting story could have thus become a great and fascinating one.
